_case: An undeclared client has appeared in the realm. Nobody reviewed its flows, its redirects or its scope; the inventory is where that gets caught, because no shape policy runs over a client the repository does not know exists.

_readme: The client INVENTORY of the `dotmac` realm. This file answers exactly one
question: WHICH clients may exist. It answers nothing about their shape —
that belongs to the class policies in policy/.
keycloak-builtin -> presence only; see the STATED PREMISE in
`provenance` records where the declaration came from. `authored-from-spec`
means it was written from ADR-0069 and has NOT been reconciled against the
live realm; every such entry is listed in docs/HOST-IMPORT-TODO.md and must
be reconciled before this repository can claim to describe the live host.
NO SECRET VALUE EVER APPEARS HERE. Client secrets live only in OpenBao;

verified App Link and Universal Link exist AND the dotmac_sub exchange
endpoint exists, this client stays DISABLED with zero redirect URIs.

note: The workspace relying party. Declared here so that the inventory check
is not vacuous: without it, the live realm's real workspace client would
read as an `inventory-unknown` failure. Its shape assertions are the
confidential-web ones and are narrower than the mobile ones by design.

realm_clients.name: Dotmac Field (native, pre-rollout)
realm_clients.description: Public native OIDC client for the field_mobile artifact. DISABLED until a verified App Link and Universal Link exist (ADR-0069 §7 / R1) and the dotmac_sub ID-token exchange endpoint exists (ADR-0069 §3). The client id matches the Android application id and the iOS bundle id, because ADR-0069 §2 makes a client per ARTIFACT identity.

realm_clients.name: Dotmac Workspace
realm_clients.description: Confidential server-side relying party for workspace.dotmac.io. Its security model rests on a server-held secret, an HttpOnly cookie and a server-side single-use state store, which is exactly why ADR-0069 §4 refuses to ship this client class to a device. The secret itself lives ONLY in OpenBao; see docs/SECRETS.md.
